title: Automaton Solo #057 (흑칠 · 금 관절 · 체형 BBW bombshell · 인종 Indian · 메이크업 비닐 블랙립 3단계 · 강함 · 배경 공연장 · 힐 40인치 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm golden-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, long straight rose pink hair — full body black enamel automaton with silver gears fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is a solid black enamel automaton body curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into fitted enamel plates, with one huge round cut-out window across her chest and belly as wide as her whole torso, showing a dense tangle of meshing gears of many sizes packed edge to edge inside a deep hollow cavity lit from within by a soft warm glow, stacked in layers at different depths with light pale-gold gaps between the layers so every gear on every layer is clearly visible, one giant gear as wide as her ribcage surrounded by medium and small gears, coiled springs and steel shafts, all turning together, and at her neck, shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees and ankles every plate ends in a round exposed hinge joint with a thin dark gap and its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted plates — BLAZING mirror-black enamel plates inlaid with silver filigree across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID silver gears with large white pearl bearings at their centres turning inside the cut-out window, bright gold joints standing out sharply against the enamel, a large silver wind-up key as long as her forearm turning slowly at her side, mirror-gloss enamelled, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the outer hip, the other raised overhead — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of the same black enamel, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, made of the same black enamel with a high polish.
Jewelry: a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and a gold belly chain with a small pendant resting on her belly plate. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT part of the automaton body — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: wet-look black gradient eyeshadow with a chrome highlight on the lids, a graphic black liner, sleek lashes, high-shine black vinyl lips like polished glass, a cool matte contour.

Background: a grand concert hall stage with a polished wooden floor, steps down to the stalls, rows of red seats and a standard-height stage door, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
